old_copy.deleted_with: the launch-video removal pull request of the writing-gate lane, which deletes tools/copy-gate/verdicts.mjs and names this folder as its new home

preserve: real bad rulings are counted once per text, only by the people the setting names and only with the field it needs
a line is caught by a row only when its own answer reaches that row's t_fail, not when the row is uncertain for another reason
promotion is allowed only at or over the number needed
counts holds every "<by> <verdict>" of the whole log
allowed_deltas: the check is not run here: the bad lines are answered first and the check's results on them are handed back as `results`, so the count needs no model and no check code
the number needed and the real people are the person's setting instead of ask-rules.json promote_when
the default kind of a ruling with none is a setting
banned_substitutions: a model call or a check run inside the count
the number needed written into the code

tools/where-a-person-stands/test/rulings-from-the-verdict-log.test.mjs the count calls a bad line caught only at or over the row t_fail
